content: Thu Masa
Jesus Christ thupualakna, a hai ngawl in hong piang tatak tu, Jesus Christ in a sal te lak tu in Pathian i a ap thu te sia vantungmi sawl a, a sal John tungah hesak hi:
John i Pathian kammal a ceptena, Jesus Christ tettipanna le a mu thu theampo tettipang hi.
Hi mailamthu pualak nate sim a, a ngai te le a ki at theampo a zui te thuphatoai a hihi: banghangziam cile a hun hong nai zo hi.
Pawlpi Sali Te

Asia ngamkhen sung a om pawlpi sali te tung ah, John in lai kong thaak hi: tu hun, a bosa hun le mailam hun a tawntung in a om Pathian kung pan ahizong, ama kumpi tokhum mai ah a om Thaa sali te tung pan ahizong;

A thuman tetti hi a, mithi te sung pan ta upabel le leitung kumpi theampo a uk Jesus Christ tung pan thuthiamna le thinnopna sia note tungah hong om tahen. Eite hong it hu in a thisan taw eite mawna te hong sawpsak a,
A Pa Pathian mai ah kumpi le thiampi in hong vawt pa tung ah; minthanna le ukzawkna a tawntung in om tahen. Amen.
En vun, ama sia meingo taw hongpai tu a; mit theampo in mu tu hi, taciang ama a sunlet te in zong mu tu uh a: leitung minam theampo Ama hang in kap tu hi. Tabang in hong piang tatak tu hi, Amen.

content.text: Keima sia Alpha le Omega, A Kipatna le A Tawpna ka hihi,

content: ci in tu hun, a bosa hun le mailam hun ah zong a om tawntung na theampo a hi thei Topa in ci hi.
Patmos Mangmuna
Jesus Christ i kumpingam le thuakna sungah na suapui le haksatna na thuakpui uh keima John sia Pathian thu le Jesus Christ tettipanna hang in Patmos tuikulh ah ka om hi.
Topa ni in Thaa sungah ka om hi, taciang ka nungsang pan in lemle bang aw nging mama ka za a,

content.text: Keima sia Alpha le Omega, amasabel le atawpna ka hihi: na mu thu te laibu sungah at in, taciang Asia ngam a om pawlpi sali; Ephesus, Symrna, Pergamos, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia le Laodicea te tungah thak in,

content: hong ci hi.
Keima hong paupui sia i aw ka zak sia en tu in ka kihei a, kham khuaimei vakna sali ka mu hi;
Taciang tua meivakna sali i laizang ah mihing Tapa taw a kibang khat ka mu hi, Ama sia a peang dong puantualpui sil a, a awm ah kham awmkam taw hen hi.
A lu le a sam te sia tuumul bang in ngo a, vuk bang in pak hi; taciang a mitte sia meikuang bang a hihi;
A peang te sia mei taw a ki thiangsak tau ngo taw kibang a, a aw sia tui tam mama i aw taw kibang hi.
A khut ziatsang ah aksi sali nei hi; a kam sung pan in langni hiam namsau pusuak a; a mai sia sun nitang bang in tang hi.
Ama ka mu ciang in, a peang ah mithi bang in ka puk hi. Taciang a khut ziatsang sia ka tungah hong nga a,

content.text: Lau heak in; Keima sia a masabel le a khakbel ka hihi:
Keima sia a nungta pa ka hihi, ka thi ngei hi; taciang en in, Keima sia a tawntung in ka nungta zo hi, Amen; taciang hell le thina i tawtang te ka nei hi.

content: At tu in Thupia

content.text: Na mu sa thu te ahizong, tu in a omlai thu te ahizong, maisang a om pheang tu thu te theampo at in;
Ka khut ziatsang a om aksi sali le kham meivakna sali na mu te thuku sia hibang a hihi. Aksi sali sia pawlpi sali te i vantung mite hi a: meivakna sali te sia pawlpi sali te a hihi.
